sections.title: Pointing and naming
sections.content: Use ez for this, az for that, and *egy* before a singular noun when introducing it: Ez egy tea.

egy isn't just "a/an" — it's also the number one. Hungarian, like Spanish (un/una) or French (un/une), uses the same word for both jobs. So Ez egy tea is technically "This is one tea" — Hungarian just doesn't mind the overlap the way English insists on keeping "a" and "one" apart.
